cover.prompt: cinematic detective cover for: The Midnight Observatory Heist. During a fierce thunderstorm, a priceless gem is stolen from the Hilltop Observatory. Players must investigate the scene, question suspects, and piece together clues to identify the thief.

backgrounds.prompt: cinematic detective background, Observatory Main Hall: The main hall of the observatory is dimly lit by emergency lights. The glass display case that held the Starfire Diamond is shattered. A thunderclap echoes outside.
cinematic detective background, Office of Dr. Vega: Dr. Vega's office is cluttered with star charts and books. A window is slightly open, letting in rain.
cinematic detective background, Library: The library has shelves of astronomy books. A map on the table shows escape routes.
cinematic detective background, Rooftop Telescope Deck: The rooftop deck is exposed to the storm. The telescope is covered with a tarp. A glint of something metallic catches your eye.

characters.prompt: cinematic detective character portrait, Dr. Vega, Astronomer: The head astronomer, a meticulous woman in her 50s. She seems nervous.
cinematic detective character portrait, Janitor Miller, Janitor: The janitor, a gruff man in his 60s. He was mopping near the hall.
cinematic detective character portrait, Professor Reed, Visiting Scholar: A visiting professor from a rival university, interested in the gem.
cinematic detective character portrait, Technician Kim, Technician: A young technician who maintains the observatory equipment. He has a limp.
cinematic detective character portrait, Security Guard, Security: The night security guard, a burly man with a flashlight. He claims to have seen nothing.

cinematic detective evidence close-up, Muddy Footprint: A clear footprint leading away from the case, size 10.

cinematic detective evidence close-up, Note: A handwritten note on Dr. Vega's desk.
cinematic detective evidence close-up, Map with Marks: A map of the observatory with a route marked in red from the main hall to the roof.
cinematic detective evidence close-up, Pair of Gloves: A pair of leather gloves, found under a chair.
cinematic detective evidence close-up, Crowbar: A crowbar hidden behind a vent on the roof.
cinematic detective evidence close-up, Gem Fragment: A small fragment of the Starfire Diamond, caught in a crevice.
